title: 1815 Prairie's corner bay steps out past its side wall
items: On the Sears-Meeker house at 1815 Prairie Avenue, the one-storey corner bay with the stone balcony sat flush with the house's south side. Both old photographs show it standing out about 0.75 m (2.5 ft) past that wall, with the upper storeys and the cornice turning the corner behind it. The bay now steps out that far, and the house's south wall has moved in to where the photographs put it. The tall stone chimney on that side moved in with it.
